documents: Original B-Form or birth certificate (child registration certificate issued by NADRA)
If both parents have passed away: death certificates and a close relative's CNIC
counter_steps: Take a token at the reception desk
Go to the document verification counter
Give your fingerprints and have your photo taken
Pay the fee at the cashier and keep the receipt
cnic_new.where: Any NADRA Registration Centre (NRC). First-time CNIC cannot be done fully online.
cnic_new.fees: Standard CNIC: Free (normal, about 15 days); Rs. 1,150 (urgent, about 12 days); Rs. 2,150 (executive, about 6 days). Smart NIC: Rs. 750 / Rs. 1,500 / Rs. 2,500.

documents: Your CNIC copy (or B-Form if under 18)
Proof of residence, such as a recent utility bill
counter_steps: Create an account on the Punjab domicile portal or visit an e-Khidmat Markaz
Fill in the application and upload or hand over your documents
Pay the fee through e-Pay Punjab
Receive the certificate by courier or collect it from the centre
domicile.where: Punjab domicile web portal or mobile app (run by PITB), or an e-Khidmat Markaz or district facilitation centre.
domicile.fees: Rs. 550 in total (Rs. 200 base fee + Rs. 300 e-affidavit + Rs. 50 service charge), paid through e-Pay Punjab. Reported as approved in April 2026.
domicile.source: Punjab domicile portal / district government website

documents: Original CNIC and a photocopy (must be valid)
Your old passport (even if expired) and a photocopy
counter_steps: Pay the fee and keep the challan or receipt
Book or confirm your appointment at the Regional Passport Office
Submit your documents at the document counter
Give biometrics and have your photo taken
passport_renewal.where: Any Regional Passport Office, or apply online at onlinemrp.dgip.gov.pk if your passport has expired or has less than 1 year left.
passport_renewal.fees: e-Passport, 36 pages: Rs. 9,000 normal / Rs. 15,000 urgent for 5 years; Rs. 13,500 normal / Rs. 22,500 urgent for 10 years.
